notes: Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. (NYSE: FDP). Vertically integrated grower / marketer of bananas, pineapples and other fresh & prepared tropical fruit & vegetables sold globally. Reports in USD with a 52/53-week fiscal year ending the last Friday of December. Data extracted from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001047340) — figures match the consolidated statements of operations and balance sheets. EBITDA computed as operating income plus depreciation, depletion & amortization (DDA). totalDebt = LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations (non-current) + LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent. Net debt = total debt - cash & cash equivalents. Significant FY24-25 deleveraging reflects pineapple-segment cash generation and asset sales (Mann Packing closure FY23, Jordan farm operations divestitures). Dividends per share materially raised from $0.60 (FY22) to $1.20 (FY25) on stronger free cash flow.

periods.notes: FY20 (53-week year ended Jan 1, 2021): COVID-impacted; banana segment held up while gold pineapple soft. Op income $76.5M + D&A $95.0M = EBITDA $171.5M. Net debt $525.5M (long-term debt $541.8M + current debt $0.2M − cash $16.5M).
FY21: revenue +1.2% YoY on banana price recovery and pineapple gold inflation. Op income $111.0M + D&A $96.8M = EBITDA $207.8M. Net debt $512.9M.
FY22: revenue +4.5% YoY on banana inflation pass-through; record net income $98.6M. Op income $156.3M + D&A $92.5M = EBITDA $248.8M.

FY23: revenue −2.7% YoY; closed Mann Packing fresh-cut vegetable operations (Salinas, CA, $54M one-time charge) and incurred Jordan operations write-down. Op income $58.5M + D&A $84.8M = EBITDA $143.3M. Net loss −$11.4M after impairments. Net debt fell to $373.7M.

FY24: record EBITDA $274.8M (op income $196.3M + D&A $78.5M). Net income $142.2M, EPS $2.97. Net debt slashed to $217.8M (-42% YoY) on FCF + asset sales (Mann property monetization). Pineapple segment volumes up, banana margins recovered.

FY25: revenue +1.0% YoY at $4.32B; op income $137.4M + D&A $72.5M = EBITDA $209.9M. Net income $90.7M, EPS $1.90. Net debt $142.0M — lowest in 8+ years (debt down to $177.7M from peak ~$725M FY18). Dividend raised to $1.20/share (+20%).
